quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A green arrow:

options.text: Is only used on one-way streets.
Means the same as a green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
Means you may proceed only if a green arrow and a circular green light both appear.
Shows the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: Means the same as a green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means the same as a circular green light. However, traffic in that lane must turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right and then curves left. You should slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: When driving at night, you should:

options.text: Stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: Stay farther back from other cars at night when it is harder to see. Use your headlights to see better. Follow the rules for using high beams and low beams. Do not look directly at oncoming headlights because the bright light can blind you.

questions.question: You may pass a vehicle when:

options.text: You are on a hill or a curve.
You are on a road with a solid line next to your lane.
You are on a road with a broken line next to your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a road with a broken line next to your lane.
questions.explanation: A broken line means you can cross it to change lanes. When you see a broken yellow line next to your lane and a solid line in the other lane, you can pass from your lane. Only change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.
A traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic light is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light ahead.

questions.question: If you see an edge line that angles inward on a road, it means:

options.text: The speed limit is getting lower.
The speed limit is getting higher.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: An edge line that angles inward means the road is becoming narrower ahead. Merge safely into the narrower lane.

questions.question: To be ready for anything on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the whole road and sides of the road constantly.
Rest your left foot lightly on the brake pedal while driving.
Keep your eyes focused on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the whole road and sides of the road constantly.
questions.explanation: Safe driving depends on spotting problems before you reach them. Do not just stare at the center of the road. Look ahead and scan the whole road, including both sides.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines down the center of a road mean passing is:
questions.correctAnswerText: Not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean traffic is going in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed from either side.

questions.question: You may never park:

options.text: Within 50 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a crosswalk.
questions.explanation: You cannot park, stop, or stand in a crosswalk. You also cannot park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.question: Water on the road can cause hydroplaning. Your car can hydroplane at speeds as low as:
questions.correctAnswerText: 35 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when water sits on the road. At speeds up to 35 mph, most tires push water away. At speeds above 35 mph, tires cannot move water as well. Your tires may lose contact with the road and slide like water skis.

questions.question: If you plan to pass another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Not assume the other driver will make room for you to return to your lane.
Assume the other driver will let you pass if you use your turn signal.
Assume the other driver will drive at the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not assume the other driver will make room for you to return to your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not assume that other drivers will give you space or the right-of-way, even if you use your turn signal.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and use a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: You may drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going the same direction. You may cross them to pass if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: At a red traffic light with a green arrow, you may proceed in the direction of the arrow if:

options.text: You first come to a complete stop.
You wait until the light changes.
You are in the correct lane and the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are in the correct lane and the road is clear.
questions.explanation: If you are in a lane with a green arrow, you may proceed in that direction when the way is clear. This is true whether the arrow is shown alone or with another signal.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.correctAnswerText: Octagon.
questions.explanation: Stop signs are eight-sided. This shape is used only for stop signs and tells drivers to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Which of the following affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.correctAnswerText: All three choices
questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating can slow down alcohol absorption, but it cannot prevent impairment if you drink too much.

questions.question: At dusk or on overcast days, you should:

options.text: Not turn on any vehicle lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your headlights.
questions.explanation: At dusk or on overcast days, turn on your headlights. Use low beam when within 1,000 feet of an oncoming vehicle and within 500 feet of a vehicle ahead. Always use low beams in poor weather.

questions.question: When double solid yellow lines separate lanes of traffic:

options.text: Passing is allowed from the left.
Passing is allowed from the right.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic moves in opposite directions. Double solid lines mean no passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.question: One strategy of defensive driving is:

options.text: Looking straight ahead as you drive.
Staying alert and keeping your eyes moving.
Expecting other drivers to make up for your mistakes.
Being confident you can avoid danger at the last moment.

questions.correctAnswerText: Staying alert and keeping your eyes moving.
questions.explanation: Traffic conditions change constantly. Scan the road ahead and keep your eyes moving. Watch what is happening on both sides of the road and check your mirrors every few seconds.
